ns2:course.label: Independent Study
ns2:course.description: Offers opportunity and challenge of self-directive, independent study; develops the individual's ability as an independent student and enables the student to pursue needed study in a field in which appropriate courses are not being offered during a given term. Approved for Letter and S/U grading. May be repeated with approval.
